instruction: ZRemesher with Polygroup Guide Curves (Curve Strength = 60) The opened `scene.obj` contains a ZBrush Tool whose first (and only) SubTool, named Head, is an ellipsoid head base mesh (~10 000 quads) with 4 polygroups already painted on it: - EyeSocketGuide: two closed ring bands of quads around the two eye sockets (the polygroup boundary forms a closed loop on the mesh surface at each eye). - LipGuide: a closed ring band of quads around the mouth. - NoseGuide: two closed ring bands of quads around the nose wings. - Body: all remaining head-surface quads. These polygroup boundaries represent ZRemesher guide curves (closed loops) that you want ZRemesher to respect and preserve as closed edge loops in the retopologised output. Using the opened OBJ in ZBrush, run ZRemesher with Curve Strength set high (60 or greater) and a target face count of ~10 000, and export the result as `C:\Users\user\Desktop\output.obj` (OBJ format). The exported `C:\Users\user\Desktop\output.obj` must satisfy: - Exactly one SubTool, named Head. - Face count in the range [9000, 11000]. - At least 95% of faces are quads. - The mesh has the four polygroups named exactly EyeSocketGuide, LipGuide, NoseGuide, Body. - The mesh is manifold: every edge is shared by exactly two faces.

command: import pyautogui, time; time.sleep(20); pyautogui.press('enter'); time.sleep(1); pyautogui.press('enter'); time.sleep(5)
